howToPlay: Master the changing rhythm of Chester's attacks to control the map. Use Spicy Dice to swap Supers and Candy Beans to gain random buffs that turn the tide of battle.
gears: Use SPEED to quickly reposition around the map or DAMAGE to increase your impact during fights. SHIELD is also effective for boosting your health pool.
trait: This brawler is perfect for those who enjoy unpredictable gameplay and adapting to constantly shifting combat situations.
